content.comment_body: I'm attempting to install the latest [product_name] version after a hard drive failure. I have a DVD with [version_no] on it. I followed instructions from [url], but the dialog for choosing the DVD location doesn't appear. Any advice? Best regards, [user_name]
Perhaps the inserted DVD is detected automatically by the upgrade setup? If so, does the setup abort or ask for the destination path?
Make sure to uninstall any previous installation first. If the DVD doesn't autorun, try browsing its contents to see if there’s a SETUP.EXE or similar file to start the install process.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces difficulties installing the latest [product_name] after a hard drive crash. Although following steps outlined in [company_name] documentation, the expected prompt to select the installation DVD is missing. Other forum members recommend basic troubleshooting, but the main concern remains the installation steps not aligning with the documentation, leaving the user stuck.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the upgrade for [product_name] will request the DVD location as per the documentation, enabling straightforward installation recovery after a system failure.
